advice.msg: `done` is declared outside this callback; a callback cannot change it
advice.do: [migration] A callback handed away (an outside call, a timer, an event) may compute, not assign an outer variable; use `for (const x of xs)` and let the state come out of the loop. A synchronous array-method callback (map, filter, reduce, some, every, find, findIndex, flatMap, forEach) is a loop body and may write the enclosing function's locals, arrays and records; so may a local procedure (a const arrow or nested function only ever called as a statement) whose parameters and locals shadow none of the function's own names.

advice.do: [migration] This name cannot be resolved in the project; a proof needs its type.
